title: CscTableAttrs
description: Attributes on viewer/tables/<table_key>/X_csc, the gene-major mirror of a sparse table's X (backend/app/persistence/store.py:_write_csc_mirror). The group also holds sibling data/indices/indptr arrays not covered by this attrs schema. Documented in docs/CHECKPOINT_FORMAT.md.

shape.description: [n_cells, n_genes], matching the mirrored table's X.shape.
